quarterly_data.quarter: Alfa Laval press release: Alfa Laval initiates full integration of Desmet to (10-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Alfa Laval is initiating the full integration of Desmet (acquired in 2022, including the operational units and brands of RoseDowns and Stolz, and run as a separate entity since then) into Business Unit Process Engineering Solutions in the Food & Pharma Division; Desmet will become a product and process technology brand within Alfa Laval, the integration happens in phases and is expected to be completed by July 2027, and the joint sales, service and supply network will extend to local teams in more than 150 countries.
quarterly_data.figure: integration expected to be completed by July 2027
